### Table `conf_paired`: Paired top-1 comparisons on C0 (n = 47 base cases).

- AURC: lower is better; cluster bootstrap over cases. op1: minimum risk with coverage >= 0.7; op2: maximum coverage with risk <= 0.1 (both chosen on calibration); n/a: not achievable on calibration. Risk CI: Wilson.
- No healthy-control trial was diagnosed at any operating point (0/108).
- Negative finding: the pre-registered composite S is worse than its margin component alone (AURC 0.214 vs 0.160, overlapping CIs), and removing the verifier-coverage signal does not hurt.
- Scores are heuristic orderings, not probabilities. Without abstention E0's selective risk is 0.321.

### Table `exp_diagnosis`: Diagnosis-level outcomes with a local LLM (qwen3:4b, prompt p4a-v1): 235 fault views (47 cases × 5 views) and 30 control views (6 controls × 5 views).

*Exploratory (Phase 4B, post-study; held-out seeds previously inspected for E0).*

| Condition | LLM calls | Top-1 /235 (rate) | Case-mean 95% CI | Top-3 /235 | Fault type /235 | Wrong service | Abstained /235 | Controls diagnosed /30 [Wilson] |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B4 (LLM only) | 265 | 74 (0.31) | [0.21, 0.42] | 182 | 48 | 160 | 1 | 30 [0.89, 1.00] |
| E1 (E0 loc. + LLM)† | 247 | 148 (0.63) | [0.54, 0.71] | 206 | 134 | 87 | 0 | 12 [0.25, 0.58] |
| E1 frozen-gated (= E0) | 233 | 148 (0.63) | [0.54, 0.71] | 204 | 134 | 85 | 2 | 0 [0.00, 0.11] |
| E2 (E1 + ownership) | 247 | 148 (0.63) | [0.54, 0.71] | 206 | 134 | 87 | 0 | 12 [0.25, 0.58] |
| B4-G (gate + B4)‡ | 233 | 74 (0.31) | [0.21, 0.42] | 181 | 48 | 158 | 3 | 0 [0.00, 0.11] |

- † E1's localization is E0's by design and its LLM is shown E0's ranking (B4's is not), so E1's top-1 is the frozen E0 result, not an LLM gain. ‡ B4-G is a hybrid, not an LLM-only baseline.
- E1 - B4 per-case top-1 difference +0.31 [0.18, 0.44] (cluster bootstrap over 47 cases). E1 is read under B4's window rule (alert window, else a median-time window), so it diagnoses on non-alerted controls; the frozen gated reading abstains there.
- E2's diagnosis equals E1's by construction: E2 does not change localization.

*Exploratory (Phase 4B, post-study; held-out seeds previously inspected for E0).*

| Claims from | Calls / diag. | Claims | Verified / observed | Rate [cluster 95% CI] | Verified per call | Root claims verified / obs. | Off-target observed | Edges verified (reversed) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| B4 (LLM) | 265 | 1574 | 454/1564 | 29.0% [25.2, 32.8] | 1.71 | 78/273 | 478 | 49/608 (359) |

| E0 templates | 233 | 1315 | 1023/1082 | 94.6% [91.9, 96.7] | 4.39 | 659/703 | 28 | 247/247 (0) |

- Rate CI: cluster bootstrap over base cases. Root claims: subject is the ground-truth root. Off-target: subject is neither the root nor a known symptom service. E0 rows cover its 233 alert-window diagnoses.
- Paired by base case (n = 53), E1 - B4 verified rate −0.039 [−0.094, 0.018]; verified root claims per case +1.51 [0.51, 2.66]. E1's model writes no more verifiable claims than B4's, but more of them concern the true root (it is shown E0's ranking).
- § E2 canonical claims are derived by deterministic code from E1's citations; they are never counted as model-written claims.
- Verifier precision and recall are unknown until the blinded human audit is adjudicated.

### Table `exp_e2`: E2 deterministic evidence ownership applied to E1's 1452 observed claims (no model call).

*Exploratory (Phase 4B, post-study; held-out seeds previously inspected for E0).*

| Disposition | Count | Rate [Wilson 95%] |
|---|---|---|
| Consistent (kept as written) | 492/1452 | 33.9% [31.5, 36.4] |
| Transformed into a canonical claim | 390/1452 | 26.9% [24.6, 29.2] |
|    with a subject-ownership correction | 352 |  |
|    with a unit change | 190 |  |
| Rejected (no admissible repair) | 560/1452 | 38.6% [36.1, 41.1] |
|    reason: record family | 372 |  |
|    reason: cited records imply different subjects | 187 |  |
|    reason: a cited record is not in the view | 1 |  |
| Not applicable (relational onset_before) | 10/1452 | 0.7% [0.4, 1.3] |
| Canonical claims verified | 152/390 | 39.0% [34.3, 43.9] |
|    first failed check V4 / V5 | 217 / 21 |  |
|    verified and about the true root | 38/152 |  |
| Verified per call: original / + canonical | 1.49 / 2.11 |  |

- E1's 3 inferred claims are outside E2's scope. A transformed claim may carry both a subject and a unit change.
- Canonical claims are system-derived and reported separately from model-written claims. E2 leaves localization unchanged and adds few verified root claims; it shares association rules with the verifier, so its verified rate is not independent evidence.

| B4-G gate: fault views missed | 2/235 [0.00, 0.03] |
| B4-G gate: correct B4 top-1 lost | 0 |
| B4-G counterfactual: calls avoided | 32 of 265 (30 control + 2 fault views; 38 min) |

- B4's model never abstained on a healthy control. B4-G removes all control false diagnoses only by adding the frozen detector; its 2 missed fault views are both strong CPU-pressure faults under MT (B4 was wrong on both). On the dev seeds the same gate missed 49/342 fault views.
- The calls B4-G avoids were in fact made (B4 is ungated); the saving is counterfactual. Control results rest on only 6 base cases.
